notes.title: Balance fixes (Build 17021562)
notes.content:
- Effect of invisibility disappears, if you shoot with firearms.
- Using the Invisible Man now costs 200 points endurance (was 100).
- Changed terms of the appearance of an extra room with equipment.
- Ultramarine herb now grants +2 to all characteristics (was +3).
- Upgrade glazed objects now restores 500 durability (was 1000).

notes.title: Rencounter Full Release (Update 1.0.0.0)
notes.content:
Many thanks to all who supported us, those who bought the early access, and those who left their suggestions and requests.
Rencounter - is the first project for our small team and we are very pleased that you've bought our game and played it.

Current version contains:
- Several types of enemies;
- Several endings;
- Over 100 items;
- Almost 50 talents.

Full release does not mean a full stop of developing. In the nearest future we will release Linux and Mac editions.
Later on we anticipate to release a series of massive updates, improving interface, gamepad support, new items, talents, enemies and much more.

We also hope for further cooperation with gaming community, write your suggestions, comments, and any other questions related to the game.
Anytime soon we will fill the Rencounter wiki, and if the game seemed a bit complicated for you, wiki will help you.


Enjoy the game,
SPVD
